name: Texas H-GAC Permitted OSSFs
_agent_notes: No street-name field exists in any layer (only Street_Number), so address is left null; lookups use coordinates. Fill later via appraisal-district parcel join.

GeoRef_Method has 22 spellings; normalized below. 'Latitude and Longitude' / 'Coordinates' = coordinates recorded on the permit (high). Appraisal/CAD/911 matches snap to the parcel or address point (medium). Street-network / Bing / Google / OCR geocodes (medium). Missing = unknown (low).
System_Classification has 1,100+ free-text values with typos (RESTOENTIAL, RESTDENTIAL). Normalized with regex rules; rows marked DUPLICATE by the county are excluded.
Source / MERGE_SRC / Authorized_Agent hold file paths and agency names, so they are excluded from the sewer-keyword scan to avoid false positives.

Review 1: 'LIFT STATION' in System_Type is the pump on an aerobic OSSF, not sewer infrastructure (27 false positives), so it is ignored by the sewer-keyword gate. Permit numbers repeat across counties (8,455 false duplicates) and 'No record' placeholders (314) were collapsing; dedupe is now per county and location-aware.
